files.content:
# Pixel Painter

A simple offline pixel art tool: a 16x16 grid, 6-color palette, eraser, clear button, and painted cell counter.

## Features

- 16x16 clickable grid
- 6 selectable colors
- Eraser tool
- Clear all button
- Live count of painted cells
- Keyboard accessible controls
- Responsive design from 360px width

## Usage

Open `index.html` in any modern browser. Click a color to select it, then click cells to paint. Use the Eraser to remove paint. Click Clear to reset the grid.

No external dependencies or network requests.
